answer: Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the thread audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 190 to 283 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the onyx identity is graded at all. A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, because the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the beacon band is published for each class. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
